title: Waima language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: The Waima language  is a Nuclear West Central Papuan Tip language of the Oceanic group of Malayo-Polynesian languages, spoken in Papua New Guinea by 15,000 people. The three dialects, Waima, Roro, and Paitana, are very close.
